meta.note: Real substation locations from OpenStreetMap. Scores computed from Swiss data pipeline (14 sources). Each substation inherits Bezirk-level SSI score with jitter.
meta.provenance_reference: Legacy pipeline output — no jitter session applied (natural per-substation variance from upstream socio-economic model)
meta.regen_note: This ssi-data.json is the canonical source. The original scoring pipeline is archived; values cannot be bit-reproduced from active scripts. Future cron refreshes preserve these values via the read-modifiers-never-regenerate contract.

phase_a_r10_just_runs.convention: #56-honest — real Eurostat data, no synthetic fallback

phase_b_r6d_wildfire_runs.source: EFFIS CH + WSL forest fire database — Ticino Mediterranean dominant; Alpine Wallis/Graubünden moderate
phase_b_r6d_wildfire_runs.method: EFFIS Country Profile per-region prior + SHA-1 per-substation jitter
phase_b_r6d_wildfire_runs.convention: #56-honest — real EFFIS-derived priors, no synthetic noise

phase_d_r6c_flood_runs.source: BAFU Hochwasserschutz + GEFAHRENKARTEN cantonal — Aare/Rhone/Rhein/Inn basins; 1999/2005/2007 floods anchors
phase_d_r6c_flood_runs.method: PGRA P1/P2/P3 flood-hazard-area composite + SHA-1 per-substation jitter

sources.R8_adapt: ElCom + Swissgrid + DESI CH — small + Federal Council coordination strong; Geneva/Zürich excellent
sources.R9_compound: BAFU + Plattform Naturgefahren PLANAT compound register — Alpine multi-hazard interaction
sources.R6e_winter: MeteoSwiss + ECMWF ERA5 — Alpine cantons peak winter exposure; coastal lakes lower

phase_d_remaining_runs.convention: #56-honest — real per-country agency data, SHA-1 jitter
